snippet.title: Security 201 (Chrome University 2019)
snippet.description:
Welcome to Chrome University, where you will learn the foundations of how Chrome works. 

Are we really attacked? Yes. 

Who attacks us? What's their motivation? How do we stop them? 

This talk will give a brief tour around adversaries, before focusing on a single bug to show its complete lifecycle from introduction, to real exploitation in the wild, to fix. 

Adrian shows how easy it is to introduce such bugs, some of the tools that attackers can use to turn a trivial vulnerability into a powerful exploit, and what you can do to frustrate their efforts.

snippet.title: SameSite Cookies - Chrome Update
snippet.description:
From Chrome 80, as part of a staged rollout, the default behavior of cookies will be changing. Cookies without a SameSite attribute will be treated as if they had SameSite=Lax set, which will restrict them to first-party only. Cookies for third-party contexts must be marked with SameSite=None; Secure. Enable this behavior in Chrome now and start testing your sites to make sure you’re ready for the change!
